observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 Slim console with two controllers: one black and one blue, both with custom skins.
Photo 1 shows the side profile of the console, revealing ventilation grilles and a disc slot.
Photo 2 shows the top of the console with the PlayStation logo and 'SONY' branding visible.
The console appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear.
No accessories (like HDMI cable, power brick, or game cases) are visible in any photo.
The seller claims '1x Original Wireless' but no wireless controller is shown in any photo.
